With Xbox Game Pass, you can play more great games anytime.

LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
An epic platform fighter for up to 8 players online or locally. Try casual free-for-alls, ranked matches, or invite friends to a private room. And it's free! Play cross-platform with millions of players on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, iOS, Android and Steam! Frequent updates. Over sixty Legends.

The Legend Rotation of nine free to play characters changes every week, and you can earn gold to unlock more Legends by playing any online game mode. 


Brawhalla will always be 100% free to play with no pay-to-win advantages.
